comment: The probes of the nightly compile-cost run. One line adds a probe. kind compile: Valgrind's instruction total of one cc1plus on `file` (docs/research/compile-time.md, 'The nightly measure'). kind stack: bytes of stack of a function, read from the report of the Arm job. threshold_percent is the change in Ir that opens an issue; it is the default when a probe names none.

probes.stands_for: every file of a user: the cost of including <lv/lv.hpp> and nothing else
the first widget of a program: one label, mounted
a screen with ten widget kinds: what each further kind costs
a large screen: the cost per node of a big tree
the quick start of the documentation: a state, a tree, a display, a PNG
one page of a real port: the printer demo's print page
